notes.title: Well... Its Here!! Relase Info!
notes.notes:
We're proudly announcing the release of TEKE TEKE - テケテケ That was created with the help of Chilla's Art!

This game is the first title of NYXTALES, a game studio run by 1 man, we want to thank everyone that was invested in the development of TEKE TEKE - テケテケ, people that support indie game developers are a necessity to the gaming community! We learned a lot! We're already planning the next release and you can be certain that with every new release you will see improvement!ːsteamthisː

Obviously TEKE TEKE - テケテケ is going to get updates based on player feedback!
